t: You're looking at 207 to 209 Piccadilly, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Alfred Waterhouse, a Victorian architect best known for Gothic Revival work. His most famous designs are Manchester Town Hall and the Natural History Museum here in London. He also designed hospitals, including University College Hospital, and many buildings for universities such as Oxford and Cambridge. So this Piccadilly frontage is by the same hand as one of London's best-known museums.
